v2-17.candidate: And the Tent of Testimony and the camp of the Levites shall set out in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each beside his neighbour according to command.
v2-17.close: And the Tent of Testimony and the camp of the Levites shall be taken up in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each beside his neighbour according to command.
